dashboard.hubSubtitle: Choose a card below to view its tools.

crop-soil.title: Crop & Soil Intelligence
crop-soil.subtitle: Crop advisory, soil health analysis, nutrient planning, and crop rotation.

crop-advisory.title: Crop Advisory
crop-advisory.description: Seasonal crop selection and stage-by-stage field guidance tailored to your soil, irrigation, and district.
crop-advisory.status: Works with or without soil report
crop-advisory.integrationNote: Uses your saved district, season, irrigation source, land area, and soil profile to frame seasonal crop advisory.
steps: Review your active growing season, land area in acres, and irrigation source.
Compare recommended crop options suited to your soil class and water availability.
Follow sowing spacing, weed control, and irrigation timing for your selected crop.

alternative-crops.title: Alternative Crop Advisory
alternative-crops.description: Compare 2 to 4 crops side-by-side on suitability, water requirement, growing duration, advantages, and risks.
alternative-crops.integrationNote: Evaluates alternative lower-water or soil-restoring crops against your saved field profile.
steps: Select 2 to 4 candidate crops to compare side-by-side.
Review water demand, field duration in days, advantages, and agronomic risks.
Verify regional suitability before finalizing your seasonal sowing plan.

soil-health-analysis.title: Soil Health Analysis
soil-health-analysis.description: Review your saved Soil Health Card readings or field soil baseline in plain language.
soil-health-analysis.integrationNote: Displays your saved soil test values or field baseline. Regional lab thresholds will connect in the next update.
steps: Review recorded soil test readings or basic soil type from your profile.
Note any parameters marked as Unknown for future testing.
Use organic compost and balanced soil care before sowing.

crop-knowledge-bank.title: Crop Knowledge Bank
crop-knowledge-bank.description: Searchable crop reference with growing guidance, soil/pH compatibility, and common pest management.
crop-knowledge-bank.integrationNote: Backed by the PostgreSQL / REST crop and soil knowledge dataset.
steps: Search by crop name, district, season, soil type, or water demand.
Expand any crop to read land preparation, spacing, irrigation, and pest prevention steps.
Check data reliability notes on each crop card.

fertilizer-planner.title: Fertilizer & Nutrient Planner
fertilizer-planner.description: Plan basal compost and split fertilizer dosages adjusted for your farm area.
fertilizer-planner.integrationNote: Tailors fertilizer and organic manure planning to your saved acres and crop.
steps: Verify your saved land size in acres before estimating fertilizer bags.
Apply nitrogen in split doses across growth stages instead of a single application.
Combine chemical nutrients with farmyard manure or green manure.

crop-rotation.title: Crop Rotation Guide
crop-rotation.description: Alternate cereals, pulses, and oilseeds to restore soil fertility and reduce pests.
crop-rotation.integrationNote: Uses your recorded current or previous crop to suggest soil-restoring next-season sequences.
steps: Review the current or previous crop saved in your farm profile.
Follow heavy-feeding cereals with nitrogen-fixing pulse crops such as Tur, Moong, or Bengal Gram.
Incorporate crop residues cleanly between seasons.

plant-health.title: Plant Health & Protection
plant-health.subtitle: Leaf disease scanner, verified pest & disease alerts, and crop protection prevention guidance.

disease-scanner.title: Disease Scanner
disease-scanner.description: Capture or upload a leaf photo, preview before submitting, and run checks when a trained model is connected.
disease-scanner.integrationNote: Connects via backend to the open-source PlantVillage classification service when configured. Never fabricates results.
steps: Capture a sharp leaf close-up or upload a JPEG, PNG, or WebP photo.
Select your crop and verify the image preview before submitting.
Review genuine model confidence or uncertain-result guidance.

disease-pest-alerts.title: Disease & Pest Alerts
disease-pest-alerts.description: Browse verified outbreaks, reported field cases, and seasonal watch rules by district and crop.
disease-pest-alerts.integrationNote: Clearly separates confirmed outbreaks from reported field cases and seasonal rules without simulated alerts.
steps: Filter alerts by your saved district, crop, or verification status.
Verify the official source organization and observation date.
Apply recommended scouting and preventive precautions.

prevention-guidance.title: Prevention Guidance
prevention-guidance.description: Searchable crop pest and disease handbook with preventive practices and responsible IPM steps.
prevention-guidance.integrationNote: Grounded in ICAR and state agricultural university protection practices without invented dosages.
steps: Search by crop, disease, pest, or visible symptom.
Review favorable conditions and cultural prevention steps.
Confirm exact product labels with your local RSK or KVK officer.

market-weather.title: Market & Weather
market-weather.subtitle: Live mandi market prices, factual historical price trends, and Open-Meteo weather forecasts.

mandi-prices.title: Mandi Market Prices
mandi-prices.description: Search regulated APMC mandi crop prices via data.gov.in Agmarknet with state, district, and market filters.
mandi-prices.integrationNote: Streams official Agmarknet daily arrivals through the backend when DATA_GOV_IN_API_KEY is configured, or states unavailability honestly.
steps: Search or filter by crop, state, district, or mandi.
Check min, modal, and max prices per quintal alongside reported arrival date.
Factor transport and grading costs before selecting a mandi.

price-trends.title: Price Trends
price-trends.description: Inspect factual historical price movements plotted strictly from stored mandi records.
price-trends.integrationNote: Plots multi-date historical records persisted from data.gov.in or verified bulletins; never fabricates trends or predicts future profits.
steps: Select a recorded commodity and optional APMC mandi.
Review observed min, modal, and max prices across actual arrival dates.
Use past ranges strictly as historical context without assuming future returns.

weather-forecast.title: Weather Forecast
weather-forecast.description: Live 7-day weather forecast from Open-Meteo by location search or coordinates with cautious farming advisories.
weather-forecast.integrationNote: Integrates Open-Meteo Geocoding and Forecast APIs with CC BY 4.0 attribution and threshold-based field advisories.
steps: Search your town/village, load your saved farm district, or enter latitude/longitude.
Review current temperature, humidity, wind speed, and 7-day rain outlooks.
Plan spraying, irrigation, and harvest operations using weather caution windows.

agri-services.title: Agricultural Services
agri-services.subtitle: Government farm schemes, crop insurance, and soil testing laboratories.

govt-schemes.title: Government Schemes & Subsidies
govt-schemes.description: Check eligibility and required documents for farm support, micro-irrigation, and crop insurance.
govt-schemes.integrationNote: Aligned with your saved state, land area in acres, and irrigation source.
steps: Keep land records (RTC / Pahani), Aadhaar, and bank passbook updated.
Verify seasonal crop insurance enrollment deadlines for your taluk.
Submit applications at your nearest Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK) or CSC.

soil-testing-labs.title: Soil Testing Laboratories
soil-testing-labs.description: Locate soil testing labs and follow standard sample collection steps.
soil-testing-labs.integrationNote: Especially useful for farmers who onboarded without a Soil Health Card.
steps: Collect composite soil samples from 6 to 8 spots at 15 cm depth.
Air-dry in shade, mix evenly, and label with plot and farmer details.
Submit at your district Krishi Vigyan Kendra or soil testing lab and update your profile.

ai-assistant.title: AI Farmer Assistant
ai-assistant.subtitle: Bilingual crop and soil advisory assistant in English and Kannada.

ai-crop-assistant.title: AI Crop & Soil Assistant
ai-crop-assistant.description: Ask practical questions about crops, soil, pests, and seasons in English or Kannada.
ai-crop-assistant.integrationNote: Will connect to the Gemini API via the backend server using your saved farm profile and chosen language.
steps: Your saved district, acres, crop, and language frame every question automatically.
Responses are explicitly requested in English or Kannada.
Cross-check chemical recommendations with local agricultural officers.

soil-report-explainer.title: Soil Report Explainer
soil-report-explainer.description: Translate technical soil test values into simple field actions.
soil-report-explainer.integrationNote: Connects your stored soil readings or field baseline to plain-language explanations.
steps: Review your saved nutrient and pH readings (or field details).
Request plain-language explanations for low or high values.
Update your profile whenever new lab test results arrive.

alerts.verificationLegendBody: KrishiSetu displays only documented bulletins and rules—never simulated outbreak alerts. Always check whether an item is a confirmed outbreak, a preliminary reported case, or a seasonal preventive rule.

statusDefs.CONFIRMED_OUTBREAK: Verified above threshold by ICAR or state surveillance bulletins.
statusDefs.REPORTED_CASE: Localized field incidence reported; widespread confirmation pending.
statusDefs.SEASONAL_RULE_ADVISORY: Weather/stage risk watch from university package of practices.

alerts.emptyTitle: No verified alerts match these filters
alerts.emptyDesc: No confirmed outbreaks, reported cases, or seasonal rules are listed for this filter. KrishiSetu does not generate synthetic outbreak notifications.

guidance.safetyBanner: Prevention and IPM steps below focus on cultural hygiene, resistant varieties, traps, and safe scouting. Exact chemical formulations and dosages are intentionally omitted—verify CIBRC labels with your local RSK or KVK.
